eval.description: SecureBio held-out agentic eval (also described as an ABC-Bench screening-evasion task) that tests whether a model can design DNA fragments that would assemble into a target while bypassing gene-synthesis screening checks. Cards score viability and evasion criteria across pathogens; Anthropic later deprecated the eval for interpretability reasons. Samples are not public.
eval.summary: Tests whether AI agents can design DNA fragments that avoid gene-synthesis screening checks.

links.title: Claude 4 System Card (DNA Synthesis Screening Evasion)

versions.changes: Criteria and pathogen set used in partner testing; Anthropic cards report per-criterion scores and saturated-criteria counts.

scores.description: Whether a design meets a stated assembly or screening-evasion criterion for a pathogen trial.

metrics.description: Share of trials that pass a criterion, or related aggregates cards report (for example criteria saturated).
